response.description: Preserve Self-EvolveRec’s diagnostic interface while adapting its probes to the actual HSTU model. Report measured diagnostics with explicit definitions, then generate an interpretation prompt grounded in those measurements and available public data.
response.motivation: Reliable diagnosis requires probes that match the trained architecture, respect left-padded histories, and distinguish observable behavior from unavailable ratings, reviews, or simulator traits.
response.implementation_notes: Retain DiagnosisProbe(view, device), run_full_diagnosis(train_loader), and diagnosis_interpreter_prompt(raw_diagnosis). Access the actual model through view.model and preserve item_emb, log2feats, predict_score, user_train, meta_data, and review_data compatibility. Process batches shaped B x L, excluding padding and invalid targets. For sequence readout, select the final nonpadding position, never count-1. Run probes in evaluation mode without gradients and restore the prior mode afterward. Report unavailable measurements explicitly rather than fabricating values. Keep one independently trained HSTU checkpoint per category and synchronize inference changes with the embedded predictor writer. Model selection uses host-measured macro validation HR@10 across all four categories; training-batch diagnostics do not substitute for that metric. Simulator recommendations cover five real training users per category and exclude previously seen items.

originality.positive: Connects architecture-specific probes to a stable diagnostic and interpretation interface.
originality.negative: Primarily an integration and measurement specification rather than a new recommendation algorithm.

future_potential.positive: Can support reproducible diagnosis and targeted improvements as the HSTU architecture evolves.
future_potential.negative: Its value depends on probe validity and whether suggested changes improve independently measured validation HR@10.

code_difficulty.positive: The existing ModelView contract and fixed batch format provide clear integration points.
code_difficulty.negative: Padding, feature shapes, target masking, and predictor consistency require careful handling; unsupported probes must be adapted or marked unavailable.
